Subject: Commit cadence — cleanroom instructions & deck submission deadlines

Team,

Quick kickoff for this month’s cleanroom/commit cycle — we need manager-owned stage updates and the leadership review pack ready for Friday. High level:

- What I need from each manager by EOD Thursday (12/17):
  - Final stage updates for all active commits (Stage, %confidence, blockers + mitigation).
  - A single-slide summary per commit using the attached leadership_slide_template.pptx (one slide per commit).
  - A CSV with commit mapping (deal id, owner, ARR, expected close month) — use Acme_commit_matrix.csv if helpful.

- Process notes:
  - Put drafts into the shared folder and mark them READY (link below).
  - If you expect a commit to move between stages during the lock window, call it out with a short rationale and evidence (link to forecast activity).
  - Security/compliance asks should be routed to procurement (procure@vendorco.com) — include SOC2 evidence if available.

Why this matters: leadership will review a consolidated pack Friday afternoon; we need tight, comparable slides to avoid follow-ups.

Attachments: cleanroom_checklist.xlsx, leadership_slide_template.pptx, Acme_commit_matrix.csv

Thanks — I’ll collate. Ping me if you need a 15-min slot to walk through a slide.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
